note: Generation | cultivation | manufacture process registry — source unto application. Status tags: [SPEC] corpus-specified, [BLUEPRINT] corpus blueprint, [LITERATURE] published ranges, [UNVALIDATED] flagged. Energy is MJ per kg of main output (midpoint or [lo,hi]).

processes.name: Moso Bamboo Plantation (stand cultivation)
processes.throughput: 20-30 t/ha/yr sustainable harvest at stand maturity
processes.efe_notes: Perennial: no replanting, soil protection, annual selective harvest of mature culms only; stand persists for decades.

processes.name: Industrial Hemp Cultivation (dual crop)
processes.throughput: 8-12 t/ha dry straw per 100-120 day crop; fiber 2-3 t/ha; hurd 3-4 t/ha
processes.efe_notes: Fastest structural-fiber crop in the inventory; phytoremediation bonus; no pesticide requirement.

processes.name: Flax (Linseed) Cultivation
processes.throughput: 4-7 t/ha straw per ~100 day crop; fiber 1-2 t/ha
processes.efe_notes: Temperate complement to hemp; linseed oil co-product feeds bio-polyol binders (aequscaff).

processes.name: Eucalyptus Plantation (managed rotation)
processes.efe_notes: Fastest timber genus on record; water demand must be sited responsibly (corpus: managed plantations, aequcity G-zone).

processes.name: Poplar Short-Rotation Coppice
processes.efe_notes: Coppice regrowth after harvest — replanting eliminated after establishment.

processes.name: Cork Oak Montado (harvest-without-killing)
processes.throughput: 100-200 kg cork/tree per 9-yr cycle (~1.7 t/ha/yr amortized)
processes.efe_notes: THE paradigm replenishable: bark regenerates; the tree is never felled; montado agroforestry is a biodiversity hotspot. Harvest is carbon-sparing by construction.

processes.name: Algae Photobioreactor (vertical farm)
processes.efe_notes: Continuous cultivation — no seasons, no fields; integrated CO2 sequestration (UMAGCONNEC carbon-negative production).

processes.name: Cape Reed Harvest (dual-ecology wetland feedstock)

key_params.dual_ecology: clears invasive Acacia mearnsii -> fynbos restoration

processes.efe_notes: Dual ecology: the harvest IS restoration. Feedstock cost is negative-adjacent (invasive-clearing subsidies).

processes.name: Natural Rubber Plantation (Hevea tapping)
processes.efe_notes: Highest carbon fraction in the inventory (polyisoprene); renewable belt elastomer for the Manufactory drive systems.

processes.name: Retting + Decortication (bast fiber extraction)
processes.efe_notes: Enzymatic retting cuts water use; field retting is solar-powered microbiology.

processes.name: Thermo-Mechanical Densification (densified laminate)
processes.efe_notes: Partial delignification + compression: strength multiplied 1.5-2x with zero new material.

processes.name: Mycelium Biofabrication (grow-to-shape)
processes.efe_notes: The factory is the organism: no cutting, no molding waste, home-compostable at EoL. Five corpus uses: insulation, EMI shield, binder, sensor substrate, packaging.

processes.name: Anaerobic Digestion (biogas + digestate)
processes.efe_notes: NET ENERGY POSITIVE (negative MJ/kg = energy out): waste becomes both the CVD methane feedstock and the fertilizer. Zero-waste pillar exemplar.

processes.name: Zero-Emission Biochar Kiln (pyrolysis)
processes.efe_notes: One process, five economies (corpus): soil, composites, electrodes, catalysts, credits. The keystone replenishable of the Carbon study.

processes.name: Lignin Recovery (biorefinery valorization)
processes.efe_notes: Byproduct valorization — the DLGC resin comes from what pulp mills burn. Zero-waste pillar in action.

processes.name: Flash Bio-Graphene (Joule-heating from biochar)
processes.efe_notes: Biochar -> graphene in seconds: the carbon apex route that makes DLGC's 3-5% bio-graphene fraction possible.

processes.name: Solar-Thermal Pultrusion (DLGC line)
processes.efe_notes: Renewable heat; night/Cloud operation via 8-hr salt buffer; the anchor manufacture process of the replenishable program.

processes.name: CLT / Glulam Mill (engineered timber)
processes.efe_notes: Rotation forestry -> engineered timber: the aequcity structural hybrid (CLT + steel) and evermateria stream 6.

processes.name: PLA Fermentation (lactic-acid route)
processes.efe_notes: The Manufactory's housings-only polymer (60 C ceiling respected by design); D3 compost loop anchor.

processes.name: PHA Fermentation (microbial polyester)
processes.efe_notes: True marine-biodegradable structural-bioplastic tier; the XEROSIL-MATRIX fungal-trigger companion.

processes.name: Geopolymer Glazing (no-lime coating)

key_params.chemistry: no lime, no C-S-H, no carbonation [corpus]

processes.efe_notes: Waste-ash chemistry protecting the replenishable flagship — two doctrines in one coating.

processes.name: FDM / Pellet / Continuous-Fiber Printing
processes.efe_notes: Print-replace philosophy: any broken part re-printed locally — repair-before-recycle extends service years.

processes.name: Greenhouse Farmplex (stackable replicable grow modules)
processes.throughput: 2-5x field yield per greenhouse layer; N-floor stacking compresses footprint N-fold

key_params.module: single greenhouse = the smallest replicable unit
key_params.aefri_gate: indoor staples only after MEASURED kWh/kg (AEFRI v0.2 finding 3: AeroFarms/Bowery/Plenty failures on grid electricity)

processes.efe_notes: Under EFE free-energy the land-for-energy trade inverts — but the gate is MEASUREMENT, not thesis. Best fiber-adjacent use: bamboo nursery modules (propagation stock shortens the 5-7 yr stand lead time). Structural fiber itself remains field agronomy.

processes.name: CIL Grow Unit (smallest complete replicable diamond grower)
processes.throughput: ~7,700 kg diamond per MW-year (285 kWh/kg floor); ~0.8 t/yr per 30 kW chamber

key_params.unit: DAC cartridge + CH4 loop + 1 CVD chamber + salt-buffered PV + in-line QC + credits hook
key_params.scaling: replicate units -> racks -> farmplex -> underground vault (thermal mass, security, zero bio-land competition)
key_params.power_ledger: 0.13 MW nameplate (~0.2 ha PV) per t/yr; 60-chamber facility ~50 t/yr ~ 7.2 MW ~ 11 ha PV
key_params.carbon_sign_threshold: per-kg negative only below ~12.9 g/kWh grid intensity; facility-level net-negativity via DAC surplus -> BIOCHAR_STORAGE

processes.efe_notes: The Seed Cell pattern (AEFRI) applied to carbon: the smallest complete replicable grow unit, then scale | stack | underground. The sky is the field; the reactor is the furrow; the seed is CO2.

processes.name: AEQUACROP — Three-Module Bio-Integrated CEA Platform
processes.throughput: passive-climate grow station; horizontal coverage: field, rooftop farm, greenhouse wall, living architecture

key_params.module_a: GROW CORE — self-contained passively climate-controlled growing station (hydroponic/aquaponic circuit)
key_params.module_b: BIO-CONVERTER — waste-to-biomaterial anaerobic digester (15 m2 floor plan); biomaterial output feeds AEQUFAB
key_params.module_c: HABITAT INTEGRATION — rooftop farm + greenhouse wall + living architecture + food processing station
key_params.scaling: 1 unit -> household -> community -> global; interface-controlled (ICD: grow-core <-> bio-converter <-> habitat <-> AEQUFAB <-> AEQUAQUA)
key_params.self_replication: bio-converter -> AEQUFAB interface: waste becomes biomaterial feedstock for fab-printed modules (infinitely self-replicable-esque, formally specified in the corpus ICD)
key_params.energy_note: passive climate control — pumps/sensors only; [MODELLED] until MEASURED (AEFRI gate)
key_params.glazing_upgrade: Thanceln enhanced transparent wood [SPEC, LITERATURE-ANCHORED]: replaces recycled-PC double-wall glazing; >=85% PAR met (literature 85-90% transmittance); haze = diffuse light improves canopy uniformity; delignification lignin byproduct feeds DLGC lignin_resin stream (38% of DLGC); bio-resin infiltration closes the bio-loop; [MODELLED] until MEASURED panel prototypes

processes.efe_notes: Wave 1 CNI substrate: food sovereignty — local, open, zero-patent. Passive climate = no grid HVAC. Closes waste->food->biomaterial->fab loop.

processes.name: AEQUIGROW v3.0 — Modular Vertical Aeroponic Farming System
inputs: water (recirculating; <0.5 L/day net loss per tower)
power (100 W PV per tower; surplus to cluster)
processes.throughput: 264-403 plants/m2 (vs 20-40 soil); conical tower = 3x yield/footprint vs flat shelves; aeroponics: 95% less water than soil, 40% less than DWC

key_params.tiers: T1 Proto (commercially sustainable) -> T2 Advanced (mycelium insulation, +20-30% yield from root temp stability) -> T3 Apex (diamond/graphene, Carbon Infinity Loop closure)
key_params.scaling: household 1-4 towers -> community 10-50 -> commercial node 100-500 -> global
key_params.energy_note: derived: 100 W x 8760 h / 15-25 kg = 35-58 kWh/kg = 126-210 MJ/kg; [MODELLED] until MEASURED (AEFRI gate)

processes.efe_notes: Highest yield per m2 of floor at lowest energy/water/material input (corpus core purpose). T3 apex tier closes into the CIL diamond atmospheric family. AEQUFAB-manufacturable = self-replicable-esque.
